conceptZh: 太空人玩偶想幫小弟弟搬疊疊樂，使勁過猛飄走，回來後輕輕放，「哥」像疊上去的兩個「可」，哥哥穩穩站高處。
object: a bouncy astronaut toy in a fishbowl helmet, a smaller matching astronaut toy, and stacked indigo toy blocks
morph: two stacked 可 shapes made of indigo blocks, built after a floating overshoot, form the glyph 哥
creativeAngle: 衝過頭：太空人玩偶一用力就飄走、撞上天花板再慢慢飄回；「哥」像兩個「可」上下疊，剛好呼應哥哥幫弟弟疊高高。
promptEn: An 8-second gentle slapstick clip on a clean solid pale baby-blue backdrop. The only text in frame is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 哥, assembled from thick glossy saturated indigo-blue toy blocks, about 70% of frame height, centered with generous margins. Lead: a bouncy astronaut toy in a fishbowl helmet who keeps drifting off the ground at the wrong moment; one supporting toy, a smaller matching astronaut toy with a little antenna. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin saying exactly 哥、哥、哥哥 (ㄍㄜ、ㄍㄜ、ㄍㄜ ㄍㄜ˙); the second syllable of the word takes the neutral tone; slow, clear tones, then silence. Moment 1 (0–1.8s): the small astronaut sits sadly under a tall teetering tower-to-be of blocks; the big astronaut bounds in and, as the first 哥 is spoken, scoops an armful of blocks and heaves them up with far too much power. Moment 2 (1.8–3.6s): the blocks and the astronaut himself shoot upward, he floats up past the top of the frame bumping his helmet on invisible ceiling, arms paddling, while the blocks rain softly into a messy heap; the small astronaut points and giggles with a squeaky wobble. Moment 3 (3.6–5s): the big astronaut drifts slowly back down with a whistle-like descent, lands gently, and on his second, calm try places each block one at a time; as the second 哥 is spoken the stack clicks into the glyph 哥, a wide upper 可 with a horizontal bar over a boxed mouth, and a second 可 stacked below it. Moment 4 (5s): as 哥哥 is spoken, the big astronaut lifts the small one by the hands onto his shoulders so the small astronaut can reach and tap the very top block, both grinning, the small one's antenna wobbling. Final 5–8s: the glyph 哥 holds perfectly still, every stroke complete, while the two astronauts stand beside it, the big one's feet drifting an inch above the floor and bobbing like a balloon, the small one clapping its mitts, with no touching of the blocks. Soft daylight, no flashing, no real people, no other text.

conceptZh: 浣熊助手花生抱著一疊高高的積木，最底下一塊小積木長腳逃跑；花生繞圈追、滑倒、絆到自己的尾巴，最後飛撲壓住小積木，被撞飛的積木疊成上下兩個「可」的「哥」，花生像哥哥一樣把小積木扛上肩拍拍頭。
object: a wobbling tower of glossy indigo building bricks carried by Peanut the cartoon raccoon, one tiny brick sprouting legs and running away
morph: the chase scatters the dropped bricks into a center heap; Peanut's belly-flop impact bounces them up and they click-stack into 哥, an upper 可 (horizontal, small box, straight vertical) on top of a lower 可 (horizontal, small box, vertical hook)
creativeAngle: 前一版是太空人輕放積木的靜態慢動作；這版改成完整的「追逐」套路：想抓、追丟兩次、飛撲大撞擊、勝利姿勢，每 1.5–2 秒換一個動作。主角固定為花生，發揮他「疊太高、敬禮時機錯」的個性；逃跑的小積木就是他疊的那一疊的一塊，所以撞擊後散落的積木直接疊成字，不另加角色群。「哥哥」一詞用花生把小積木扛上肩、拍頭的哥哥動作來呼應，不用任何字幕。
promptEn:
An 8-second cartoon chase gag on a clean, solid pale cream backdrop with soft even daylight, nothing in the background. The only text in the whole clip is one large Traditional Chinese glyph 哥, built from thick glossy saturated indigo-blue building bricks, about 70% of frame height, centered with generous margins, never cropped. Lead: Peanut, a round-bellied cartoon raccoon sidekick with a striped tail, a small cap and oversized paws, who carries a wobbling stack of bricks far too tall for him and salutes at exactly the wrong moments. Supporting element: the bricks themselves, especially one tiny runaway brick that sprouts two little legs. No other characters, no real people, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no background music, no flashing.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly these syllables, slowly and distinctly with clear tones: 哥、哥、哥哥 (ㄍㄜ、ㄍㄜ、ㄍㄜ ㄍㄜ˙). Short pause between the first two, the final syllable of 哥哥 light and unstressed, then silence. Nothing else is spoken.

Moment 1, want it (0 to 1.5s): Peanut trots in from the left hugging a teetering tower of ten indigo bricks taller than himself, eyes peeking around the side. The bottom brick pops out two tiny legs and scoots off to the right with a squeaky patter. Peanut snaps a proud salute at the wrong moment, the tower lurches sideways, and he points a paw at the runaway with wide eyes. The first 哥 is spoken right here, as the tiny brick dashes off and Peanut points at it.

Moment 2, try and miss (1.5 to 3.5s): the tiny brick zips in a small loop around the center of the frame; Peanut chases in a bigger loop, tower swaying, skids round an invisible corner with his legs spinning, and overshoots. Second lap, bigger still: he trips over his own striped tail, tumbles into a somersault, and bricks fly off the tower one at a time, bouncing into a loose heap at the center of the frame. He pops up, cap crooked, and shakes his head with a rattle. The runaway brick pauses at center, taps a little foot, and waves.

Moment 3, the big crash (3.5 to 5s): a frozen half-second of anticipation, Peanut crouched, bottom wiggling, then a huge flying leap across the frame and a cartoon belly-flop SPLAT right onto the runaway brick, squashing flat and stretching wide. The impact bounces every heaped brick into the air, and as the second 哥 is spoken they click-stack mid-fall into the glyph 哥: on top a 可 shape made of a long horizontal brick, a small square box of bricks tucked under its left side, and a straight vertical brick on the right dropping down; below it a second 可 made of another long horizontal, a small square box on the left, and a vertical brick on the right that ends in a short hook turning left. Every stroke is complete and correctly placed, the finished glyph centered and filling about 70% of frame height. Peanut lies dazed beside the glyph with a dizzy grin and spinning stars, the caught brick held gently in both paws.

Moment 4, payoff and hold (5 to 8s): the glyph 哥 stays perfectly still and readable for the full final 3 seconds, nobody touches it. At about 5.5s, as the word 哥哥 is spoken, Peanut sits up, lifts the tiny brick onto his shoulders like a proud older brother carrying a little one, and pats its top with one paw; the tiny brick kicks its legs happily. The brick gives a crisp little salute and Peanut returns the salute a beat too late, knocking his own cap sideways, then holds a wobbly, beaming victory pose to the side of the glyph until the end. Bright but not neon colors, no pure white blowouts, no dark grading, no extra text or watermark.
